title: Pokemon meets yugioh
author: sambranaivan
selftext:
​Testing a playable alpha of "Yugimon" (Yu-Gi-Oh! x Gen III Pokémon RPG) — Built with Local AI + Blender MCP, now upgrading sprites with Gemini

​Cuerpo:

​A while ago I started Yugimon with a simple premise: what if Duelist Kingdom were a Gen III Pokémon-style RPG?

​Here's a full 6v6 duel from the playable early alpha. You manage a team of 6 monsters alongside a support Deck (Spells, Traps, and Techniques), taking one action per turn, triggering Traps manually at key moments, and tracking status effects directly on the sprites.

​About the visuals:

Every asset currently on screen was made combining local AI models and Blender MCP. Now that the mechanics are solid, I'm actively overhauling the art and remaking the sprites in higher quality using Gemini.

​Everything is subject to change since it's a fan project in active development. Happy to answer questions about the Blender MCP / AI asset workflow—and let me know which card you'd like to see in action next!
